lines: Arz-e-niyaz-e-ishq ke qabil nahin raha
couplets.en: I can no longer give voice to the supplication of love.

lines: Arz-e-niyaz-e-ishq ke qabil nahin raha
Jis dil pe naaz tha mujhe, woh dil nahin raha
couplets.en: I can no longer plead in love, for the heart I once took pride in is gone.

lines: Jaata hoon daagh-e-hasrat-e-hasti liye hue

lines: Jaata hoon daagh-e-hasrat-e-hasti liye hue

couplets.en: I leave with the scar of my longing for life, an extinguished candle with no place in the gathering.

lines: Wa kar diye hain shauq ne band-e-naqab-e-husn
